rules.statement: The running of prescription in favor of the defendant was not arrested merely because he had left the temple in obedience to the decree of Court in action No. 3760.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is the duty of the Courts to see that no party is placed at a disadvantage by an act of Court."

meta.parties: U.Deerananda Thero v. D. Ratnasara Thero
